name: Yellow Memory Boost!
main_effect:
[Main] Reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 yellow Digimon card among them to the hand. Place the remaining cards at the bottom of your deck in any order. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・Gain 2 memory.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Place this card in the battle area.
